items.es: I'd like to open an account.
Where's an ATM?
items.nota: ATM = caixa eletrônico. No Reino Unido: "cash machine".

items.es: The ATM ate my card.
items.pt: O caixa eletrônico engoliu meu cartão.
items.nota: "Ate" é informal. Mais formal: "kept my card".

items.es: What's the fee?
I want to make a transfer.
What's the exchange rate?
I need to withdraw some money.
Do you have change for a fifty?
I was charged twice.
I lost my card and want to block it.
What's my account balance?
items.pt: Qual é o saldo da minha conta?

items.es: I'd like to apply for a loan.
Can I pay in installments?
I don't have any cash on me.
Sign here, please.
I need your ID.
items.pt: Preciso do seu documento de identidade.

items.es: I'd like to speak to the manager.
items.pt: Gostaria de falar com o gerente.

items.es: We don't accept hundred-dollar bills.
items.pt: Não aceitamos notas de cem dólares.
items.nota: Nos EUA a nota é "bill"; no Reino Unido, "note".

items.es: Is there a fee for paying by card?
I save a little every month.
